thread:
Rina (Marketing): quick ask: we need a tiny, reproducible bench to validate two claims for the launch poster: (1) q4_0 improves coldstart throughput vs fp16, (2) 95p latency for short prompts <120ms on redwood-7b. deadline: Thu EOD. can runtime run a single-host A/B and drop artifacts?

Jules (Runtime): doable. small = how many prompts and repeats? coldstart only or warmup too?

Rina (Marketing): 25 short prompts, please run coldstart + 3-request warmup for the same pack. repeats = 2 per config. configs: redwood-7b-v2 (fp16) and redwood-7b-v2-q4_0. serial invocations (no concurrency). single GPU host.

Sam (EngRuntime): got it. we'll capture raw per-request latencies, 50/95/99 percentiles, and include run metadata (image tag, model sha, quant profile, instance type). token-level timings optional; skip unless needed.

Marta (Product): please pin model build id and quant-tool version in artifacts; marketing will call them out.

Jules (Runtime): scheduling now. will run on a pinned clean host and disable prefetch to keep coldstart deterministic. will post CSV + README + short caveats.

benchbot: created job id=mini-4312340000 runner=single-host-gpu configs=[fp16,q4_0] repeats=2 est=30m

benchbot: job mini-4312340000 completed; artifacts uploaded: https://redwood-internal/artifacts/mini-4312340000 (raw_latencies.csv, percentiles.csv, run_metadata.txt, NOTES.md, marketing_blurb.txt)

Rina (Marketing): excellent. downloading. if variance >10% we'll ask for a 2nd run with longer warmup. thanks team :tada:
